_doc: The ENGINE's own structured reason for each refused cell, read off the server's log on the rig. The harness records `reasons: ['unknown']` for a vLLM launch that never reached health, because the process it waited on died on the host and its exception was never on the wire; the campaign's third void_if is that a refusal without the engine's reason cannot be told from a harness bug, so it is read from the log instead. Nothing here was re-tuned to make a cell load.
_capture: srv1 is a pip deployment and writes /tmp/vllm-serving.log; srv2 is a container and writes to `docker logs mcgyvr-vllm`. srv2's Qwen3-4B container was destroyed by the NEXT vLLM cell's `docker rm -f`, so that one cell was re-run byte-identically (config-rerun-srv2-qwen3-4b.json) purely to re-obtain the reason; it refused the same way.
